situation (example wording): "Big cities with highest share of murders via firearm in 2024", "Big cities with the highest number of homicides by knife or sharp object", "Big cities with the highest % of teenage homicide victims (13-19)"
what the app does today: Routed to the Homicide Reports tab with "Homicide Reports aren't available here yet; the Homicide Reports tab has them".
proposed behavior: With a Homicide Reports release loaded, big cities (Crime Index city agencies of 250,000 or more, the population of the last year of the period) are ranked from Homicide Reports by their murder or homicide victims with a firearm, a knife (the weapon code Knife or cutting instrument) or aged 13 to 19 (teen, teenage; P120 makes this the reading for every question), as a count or as the detail's share of the city's victims, highest first, 20 rows unless a number is named. Only cities that filed Homicide Reports in every year of the period are ranked; one note says "Not every city reports Homicide Reports data. Cities that did not report in this period are not ranked." and no left-out city is named. A share needs a murder victim. No period named: the period is asked, with the latest complete year as the button. Other details (a juvenile, a race, a relationship) stay routed to the Homicide Reports tab; without a release it stays routed.
exact default or choices offered: "Big cities with highest share of murders via firearm in 2024" ranks Dallas, Houston and the other filing cities by share.
why: Jeff 2026-11-15 via coordinator: "Get 1 and 2 moving" (SHR-B, Homicide Reports placeholders). The ranking wording and the 13 to 19 reading of teenage are Engine 2.0's, Jeff approved the lines on 2026-11-15, with the note on left-out cities in place of naming them.
status: Decided 2026-11-15 (Jeff); "no period named: the period is asked" superseded by P181 (2026-11-21: a ranking with no period is the latest complete year, said)
test cases: Tests that ask its example question: scripts/test-nibrs-shadow.ts.
